description: Source code for an OPAE file creation wizard in an Odoo module, including classes for handling payment lines, file generation, and wizard interface.

classes.name: OPAELine
classes.description: Represents a line in the OPAE file, handling data formatting and control sector creation.

classes.name: OPAE
classes.description: Represents the entire OPAE file, managing lines, footer, and file output generation.

methods.name: get_date
methods.description: Returns the formatted date for an OPAE line based on payment and line data.

methods.name: set_communication
methods.description: Splits communication text into 4 blocks of 35 characters for the OPAE line.

methods.name: set_address
methods.description: Sets address fields in the line's component dictionary.

methods.name: _create_control_sector
methods.description: Creates the control sector string for the OPAE line.

methods.name: _format_post_account
methods.description: Formats a postal account number into the required string format.

methods.name: escape_vals
methods.description: Normalizes and encodes string values to ASCII.

methods.name: _generate_dest_bank_string
methods.description: Generates the destination bank string based on transaction type and account info.

methods.name: generate_string
methods.description: Generates the full string representation of an OPAE line.

methods.name: get_lines_order_num
methods.description: Returns the next available order number for a line based on date and currency.

methods.name: create_opae_footer
methods.description: Creates the footer string for the OPAE file.

methods.name: parse_payment_lines
methods.description: Parses payment order lines to generate corresponding OPAE lines.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Computes the final OPAE file content as a string.
